1. Workable — Overview

Workable is end-to-end recruitment platform that scales from first hire to hundredth.. In our testing over two weeks of real recruitment scenarios, we found it to be a standout performer in the all-round recruitment category.

This review is based on hands-on testing with real recruitment workflows, analysis of 1876+ user reviews across Trustpilot, G2, and Reddit, and pricing verification direct from the vendor. We are not sponsored by Workable. Some links may be affiliate links.

Pros and Cons

Pros

  • The AI sourcing is genuinely effective. One agency sourced three qualified candidates for a niche role in 24 hours
  • Job description writer produces inclusive, professional copy
  • The collaborative scoring system reduces bias
  • Integration with 200+ job boards means one-click posting
  • Customer support includes live chat with recruiters who understand the hiring process

Cons

  • At £99/month, it is an investment for agencies placing fewer than 10 roles per month
  • The AI ranking occasionally misses context
  • Advanced analytics require the Professional plan (£299/month)
  • Some users report the mobile app lacks features available on desktop
  • Integration with some UK payroll systems requires middleware or manual exports

What Users Say

What Users Say

  • The AI sourcing found candidates we would never have discovered through traditional advertising.

  • Workable reduced our time-to-hire from 6 weeks to 10 days for seasonal recruitment.

  • Good but expensive for our small agency. We only use the Starter tier.

    Agency OwnerBoutique Recruitment, BrightonRedditNeutral

Final Recommendations

Startup or SME (under 50 employees): Workable (£99/month) for ATS and sourcing. Add TestGorilla (£59/month) if you hire for technical roles. Total: £158/month.

Growing agency (50-200 employees): Workable Professional (£299/month) + HireEZ (£125/month) for sourcing + BambooHR Pro (£9/user) for onboarding.

Healthcare staffing agency: Occupop (£149/month) for compliance-heavy recruitment. Add HireEZ (£125/month) for passive candidate sourcing.

Enterprise or high-volume hiring: Greenhouse (£200+/month) for structured hiring + HireVue (£5,000+/year) for video assessment + Teamtailor (£165/month) for employer branding.

The complete recruitment stack: Workable (£299/month) + HireEZ (£125/month) + TestGorilla (£119/month) + BambooHR Pro (£9/user) = approximately £543/month plus per-user fees for a data-driven, efficient recruitment operation.
